polymorphic_aggregate_extensions.comments: Inferred ARRAY_AGG and ANY_VALUE retain logical schemas across distributed and direct aggregation. Values are identical within each group so unordered collection and ANY_VALUE outputs are deterministic.

queries.description: Inferred numeric, string, boolean, timestamp and exact long arrays retain their element types
queries.sql: SELECT group_id, ARRAY_AGG(numericValue), ARRAY_AGG(textValue), ARRAY_AGG(flag), ARRAY_AGG(moment), ARRAY_AGG(bigValue) FROM {items} WHERE group_id <> 'nulls' GROUP BY group_id

queries.description: Boolean distinct option selects existing set accumulators for logical arrays
queries.sql: SELECT group_id, ARRAY_AGG(numericValue, true), ARRAY_AGG(textValue, true), ARRAY_AGG(flag, true), ARRAY_AGG(moment, true) FROM {items} WHERE group_id <> 'nulls' GROUP BY group_id

queries.description: MV input flattens to one array dimension, with and without deduplication
queries.sql: SELECT group_id, ARRAY_AGG(intValues), ARRAY_AGG(intValues, true) FROM {items} WHERE group_id <> 'nulls' GROUP BY group_id

queries.description: Empty global aggregation preserves the declared logical array types
queries.sql: SELECT ARRAY_AGG(numericValue), ARRAY_AGG(textValue), ARRAY_AGG(flag), ARRAY_AGG(moment), ARRAY_AGG(bigValue) FROM {items} WHERE group_id = 'missing'

queries.description: All-null scalar input produces empty arrays without changing result types
queries.sql: SELECT ARRAY_AGG(numericValue), ARRAY_AGG(textValue), ARRAY_AGG(flag), ARRAY_AGG(moment) FROM {items} WHERE group_id = 'nulls'

queries.description: Direct aggregation retains array and scalar logical types without a leaf accumulator
queries.sql: SELECT /*+ aggOptions(is_skip_leaf_stage_aggregate='true') */ group_id, ARRAY_AGG(flag, true), ARRAY_AGG(moment, true), ANY_VALUE(textValue) FROM {items} WHERE group_id <> 'nulls' GROUP BY group_id

queries.description: ANY_VALUE retains exact LONG, STRING, BOOLEAN and TIMESTAMP values across stages
queries.sql: SELECT group_id, ANY_VALUE(textValue), ANY_VALUE(bigValue), ANY_VALUE(moment), ANY_VALUE(flag) FROM {items} GROUP BY group_id

queries.description: Scalar post-aggregation resolves from ANY_VALUE logical return types
queries.sql: SELECT UPPER(ANY_VALUE(textValue)), fromTimestamp(ANY_VALUE(moment)) = ANY_VALUE(fromTimestamp(moment)), ANY_VALUE(bigValue) FROM {items} WHERE group_id = 'a'

queries.description: Empty ANY_VALUE global aggregates retain schema and return null
queries.sql: SELECT ANY_VALUE(textValue), ANY_VALUE(bigValue), ANY_VALUE(moment), ANY_VALUE(flag) FROM {items} WHERE group_id = 'missing'

queries.description: Empty grouped ANY_VALUE produces no groups
queries.sql: SELECT group_id, ANY_VALUE(bigValue) FROM {items} WHERE group_id = 'missing' GROUP BY group_id
